title: Create purchase returns from authorized receipt selection and remaining capacity
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add bounded purchase-return source receipt candidate/detail endpoints requiring live enabled purchase-return and stock-in permissions and existing receipt/procurement ownership scope before counts/rows. Resolve exact approved nondeleted receipt id/no, supplier/warehouse/product/spec/base unit and remaining return capacity from effective approved returns with duplicate source products aggregated safely. Zero capacity, corrupt/unknown units, cancelled/deleted/unapproved and foreign-owned receipts are unavailable. Reuse ERP358 unit/cost and scope conventions without new grants or schema.

Add functional explicit receipt selection to purchase-return create/edit, authoritative SourceStockInId/no/supplier/warehouse and eligible product lines with positive partial quantities. Save/reopen keeps exact source, explicit clearing retains legacy unlinked semantics and no text matching. Preserve existing unit/cost/amount calculations; no synthetic AP payments, stock or finance posting from selection. Actual create/submit/approval rechecks eligibility and cumulative return capacity under existing source locks; stale source cancellation, revoked access, concurrent returns and invalid edits roll back without altering original document/stock/ledger. Retain form input on failure and avoid repeated clicks. Real SQL atomic denial, partial/duplicate/foreign/revoked/stale/race and executable JS selection/save/reopen tests plus browser evidence or accurate blocker.
